Ayam Penyet.note: Sambal terasi = shrimp paste = crustaceans; fried tempe and tahu = soy. No batter stated. Described spicy = 2. Certified branch: halal.

Ayam Bakar.note: Kecap manis = soy + gluten; sambal terasi (shrimp paste) on the side; tempe/tahu. Chilli condiment on the side with no heat word = 1.

Ikan Penyet.note: Tilapia = fish; sambal terasi; tempe/tahu. Spicy.

Tempe Tahu Penyet.note: Tempe and tahu = soy; sambal terasi (shrimp paste) = crustaceans, so NOT vegetarian. Spicy.

Bebek Penyet.note: Duck; sambal terasi; tempe/tahu. Spicy. Sold out.

Empal Penyet.note: Beef with coriander, galangal, palm sugar (no soy sauce stated); sambal terasi; tempe/tahu. Spicy.

Nasi Uduk Komplit.note: Telur balado = egg; kecap manis in the bihun and sweet-soy tempe orek = soy + gluten; sambal terasi = crustaceans. Coconut milk not milk. Emping (melinjo, Gnetum gnemon) is not a regulated tree nut. Spicy.

Nasi Goreng Jawa.note: Kecap manis = soy + gluten; fried egg. No shrimp paste stated. Mildly spicy = 1.

Soto Ayam.note: Boiled egg; celery leaves = celery; koya made of prawn crackers = crustaceans. Rice vermicelli, no gluten. Chilli sambal on the side = 1.

Mie Ayam Jamur.note: Wheat and egg noodles; kecap manis and soy sauce. Pickled chilli on the side = 1.

Sop Buntut.note: Celery; nutmeg and clove are spices, not tree nuts; emping not a tree nut. Stated not spicy.

Gado-Gado.note: Peanut sauce (stated no shrimp paste); tofu and tempe = soy; boiled egg, so vegetarian not vegan. Lontong is rice. Mildly spicy = 1.

Nasi Uduk.note: Coconut rice; coconut is not milk or a tree nut.

Combo Ayam Penyet.note: Ayam Penyet + default Es Teh Manis (vegan). Lunch combo only.

Combo Ayam Bakar.note: Ayam Bakar + default Es Teh Manis. Lunch combo only.

Combo Tempe Tahu.note: Tempe Tahu Penyet (sambal terasi, not vegetarian) + Es Teh Manis. Lunch combo only.

Jus Alpukat.note: Condensed milk. Avocado is not a tree nut. Chocolate syrup: no allergen stated.

Es Teler.note: Condensed milk; coconut milk is not milk; grass jelly no allergen.

Es Cendol.note: Rice flour jelly (no gluten), coconut milk, palm sugar.
